name: Scroll Expand
description: Scroll-driven media reveal where a small rounded image or video frame expands to fill the whole container while a title fades out and overlay content fades in.
contents: Full-size image or looping muted video that is clipped to a small rounded frame at the start
Optional centered title and bottom scroll hint text
Optional overlay area for children that appears once the media is fully expanded
Dark gradient scrim that fades in over the media as it expands
behavior: Clip-path inset grows from startWidth/startHeight percent to full size with eased (smoothstep) progress
Corner radius animates from startRadius to endRadius
Media scales from mediaZoom down to 1 while expanding
Title fades up and out between 40% and 88% progress, scroll hint fades out in the first 12%
Children overlay fades and slides in from 68% to 100% progress
Progress is smoothed with a requestAnimationFrame lerp controlled by smoothing, and applied instantly when smoothing is 0 or the user prefers reduced motion
Stage is sticky while a tall track provides the scroll range
Recomputes sizes on window resize and container resize
editableByProps: Media source, image or video type, poster and alt text
Title, scroll hint and overlay content through children
Starting frame size and corner radii, media zoom and scrim strength
Scroll length, hold length and smoothing
Scroll container: internal scroller or the window (useWindowScroll)
Disable the effect so the media shows fully expanded (enabled=false)
Extra props and style are passed to the root element

needsCodeEdit.change: Change title size range or text shadow
needsCodeEdit.where: --se-title-size clamp in the measure function and the title div classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change timing of title, hint and overlay fades
Use a different frame shape than a rounded inset

fixed: Root is w-full h-full, so the parent must have a defined height (for example h-screen) when useWindowScroll is false, otherwise the stage collapses
By default the root becomes its own hidden-scrollbar scroll container with overscroll-contain, so page scroll does not drive it; set useWindowScroll to use page scrolling
In window mode the stage height equals the window height and the component adds scroll room of about 2.5 viewport heights by default
Title and scroll hint text are white with fixed styling, so they need a media with enough contrast
Video is always autoplay, muted, looped and playsInline, with no controls
No frame added: it is a full-bleed section layout
Works on small screens, sizes are measured from the container and title size scales with width
